name: Alice Thornton
headline: Astrophysicist | Exoplanet research at JPL
biography: Research scientist at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory studying atmospheric signatures of exoplanets. Previously worked on the James Webb Space Telescope instrument team. Writing about what we're learning from the universe and why it matters.

name: Marcus Webb
headline: Space Systems Engineer | Lunar Gateway program
biography: Systems engineer working on the Lunar Gateway space station. Twelve years in aerospace, previously on Orion capsule thermal systems. Writing about the engineering realities of deep space exploration that never make the press releases.

name: Priya Nair
headline: Planetary geologist | Mars surface research
biography: Studying the geological history of Mars using data from Curiosity and Perseverance rovers. PhD from Caltech. Writing about what Martian rocks tell us about whether life was ever possible on the red planet.

name: Jordan Cole
headline: Amateur astronomer | Dark sky advocate
biography: Software developer by day, telescope builder by night. Running a dark sky preservation society in rural Montana. Writing about practical amateur astronomy, light pollution activism, and the joy of seeing the Milky Way with naked eyes.

name: Sophie Laurent
headline: Aerospace engineer | Rocket propulsion systems
biography: Propulsion engineer at a commercial launch startup. Previously at ESA on Ariane 6. Spent years thinking about combustion instability and why rockets explode. Writing about the unglamorous engineering that makes space access possible.

name: Rafael Costa
headline: Astronomer | Radio telescope imaging
biography: Radio astronomer at a national observatory. Work focuses on mapping hydrogen gas in distant galaxies. Writing about what radio telescopes hear that optical instruments miss, and the surprising politics of spectrum allocation.

name: Hannah Park
headline: Astrobiologist | Origins of life research
biography: Researching the chemical conditions that might have led to life on early Earth and potentially elsewhere. NASA astrobiology fellow. Writing about the intersection of chemistry, geology, and biology in the search for life beyond Earth.

name: Dmitri Volkov
headline: Cosmologist | Dark matter and large-scale structure
biography: Theoretical cosmologist working on models of dark matter distribution and the large-scale structure of the universe. Writing about the 95% of the universe we cannot directly observe and why it keeps cosmologists up at night.

name: Camille Dubois
headline: Classics professor | Greek mythology and ancient religion
biography: Professor of Classical Studies at a French university. Research focuses on the religious function of Greek mythology and its transmission through art and literature. Writing about what the myths actually meant to the people who told them.

name: Omar Shaikh
headline: Ancient historian | Bronze Age Mediterranean cultures
biography: Historian specialising in the Bronze Age collapse and its relationship to Greek mythological tradition. Author of two books on the historical roots of the Trojan War. Writing about the boundary between myth and history.

name: Yuki Tanaka
headline: Comparative mythologist | Greek and Japanese tradition
biography: Comparative literature scholar studying structural parallels between Greek and Japanese mythology. Writing about the universal patterns in hero myths, creation stories, and the underworld across cultures.

name: Leila Hassan
headline: Museum curator | Ancient Greek art and artefacts
biography: Curator of Greek and Roman antiquities at a major natural history museum. Specialising in vase painting as mythological narrative. Writing about what material culture tells us that texts cannot.

name: Ben Fletcher
headline: Writer and translator | Greek epic poetry
biography: Translator of Hesiod and Pindar. Working on a new verse translation of the Homeric Hymns. Writing about the challenges of bringing ancient poetry into modern English without killing what makes it alive.

name: Natasha Ivanova
headline: Philosopher | Ethics and Greek moral thought
biography: Philosophy professor focusing on virtue ethics and its Greek foundations. Teaching Plato and Aristotle to undergraduates who had no idea they needed them. Writing about what ancient moral philosophy still has to teach us.

name: Chris Morgan
headline: Novelist | Greek mythology retelling
biography: Author of three novels retelling Greek myths from unexpected perspectives. Most recent book told the story of the Trojan War from the point of view of Cassandra. Writing about the craft of giving ancient characters modern interiority.

name: Aisha Williams
headline: Classicist | Women in Greek mythology
biography: Scholar focused on female figures in Greek myth — how they were written, how they were painted, and how those representations have shaped Western ideas about women for two thousand years. Writing about reclaiming these stories.

name: Lucas Muller
headline: Shakespeare scholar | Performance and textual history
biography: Academic and theatre practitioner specialising in the performance history of Shakespeare's plays. Research focuses on how different eras have staged the same texts to mean entirely different things. Writing about Shakespeare as a living tradition.

name: Grace Kim
headline: Literary critic | 20th century American fiction
biography: Critic and essayist writing about the American novel from Fitzgerald to the present. Contributor to several literary journals. Writing about what fiction reveals about a society that straightforward history cannot.

name: Thomas Andersen
headline: English professor | Tragedy and the dramatic tradition
biography: Teaching Shakespeare, Marlowe, and the Jacobean dramatists. Research focuses on the political dimensions of Elizabethan tragedy. Writing about the plays as documents of their historical moment and as works that still speak to ours.

name: Maya Patel
headline: Author and book critic | Contemporary literary fiction
biography: Novelist and book critic based in London. Three novels published, a fourth on the way. Writing about reading and writing — the craft decisions behind the best contemporary fiction, and why so much published fiction fails to take risks.

name: Diego Ramirez
headline: Poet and translator | Spanish and English literary tradition
biography: Poet working in both Spanish and English. Translator of Garcia Lorca and Pablo Neruda. Writing about the impossible task of translation, the politics of which voices get brought into English, and poetry as a form of resistance.

name: Zoe Chen
headline: Book editor | Literary fiction and narrative nonfiction
biography: Senior editor at a literary press. Fifteen years working with writers to make their books better than they thought possible. Writing about what makes a manuscript publishable, what editors actually do, and the economics of literary publishing.

name: Patrick Brennan
headline: Irish literature specialist | Yeats and the Celtic Revival
biography: Scholar of Irish literature from the Celtic Revival to the present. Research on Yeats, Synge, and Beckett. Writing about the relationship between literature and national identity in Ireland and what that history means now.

name: Fatima Al Rashid
headline: Novelist | Historical fiction and the medieval Islamic world
biography: Author of historical novels set in the medieval Islamic world. Research for fiction led to a serious study of how Western literature has written — and miswritten — the Islamic Golden Age. Writing about accuracy, imagination, and responsibility in historical fiction.

name: Sam Torres
headline: Historian | Early American colonial period
biography: Historian of colonial North America at a research university. Specialising in the social history of the seventeenth century — labour, land, disease, and the communities that survived the first century of European colonisation.

name: Elena Popescu
headline: Civil War historian | Memory and commemoration
biography: Historian of the American Civil War and its long aftermath. Current research on how Confederate monuments became political tools in the twentieth century. Writing about how societies remember — and misremember — their most divisive events.

name: Noah Jackson
headline: Canadian historian | Confederation and the railway era
biography: Historian of nineteenth-century Canada. Research on the politics of Confederation and the construction of the transcontinental railway. Writing about Canadian history for general readers who were told it was boring and deserved better.

name: Clara Santos
headline: Indigenous history scholar | Land and sovereignty
biography: Scholar of Indigenous history in North America, focusing on treaty rights, land dispossession, and the residential school system. Writing about the history that most national curricula still do not teach.

name: James Li
headline: Historian | Immigration and the making of North America
biography: Historian of immigration in North America from the mid-nineteenth century to the present. Research on Chinese railroad workers, Japanese internment, and the political construction of borders. Writing history that connects to present debates.

name: Ingrid Berg
headline: Historian | The American West and frontier mythology
biography: Historian of the American West. Research on how the frontier myth was constructed, who it served, and what it erased. Writing about the gap between the West of history and the West of popular imagination.

name: Kevin Walsh
headline: Public historian | Museums and community memory
biography: Public historian working with communities to document and preserve their own histories. Former museum director. Writing about who gets to tell history, who gets left out, and how to change that.

name: Ana Oliveira
headline: Political historian | The Great Depression and New Deal
biography: Historian specialising in the political economy of the 1930s United States. Research on the New Deal coalition, labour organising, and the politics of economic crisis. Writing about what that decade still teaches us.

name: Felix Wagner
headline: NHL analyst | Advanced statistics and player development
biography: Hockey analyst working with an NHL franchise on player evaluation and draft analytics. Former ECHL player. Writing about how the game has changed with data, what analytics still cannot capture, and the future of player development.

name: Mia Johnson
headline: Hockey journalist | The Athletic
biography: Hockey beat writer covering the game at the NHL and junior levels. Ten years on the road, in the dressing rooms, and behind the benches. Writing about what the game looks like up close and what gets lost in the broadcast.

name: Carlos Mendez
headline: Hockey coach | Minor league and junior development
biography: Junior hockey coach with twenty years of player development experience. Coached three first-round NHL draft picks. Writing about skating mechanics, systems, and the mental side of developing young players who want to make it.

name: Fiona Clarke
headline: Women's hockey advocate | PWHL and the fight for a pro league
biography: Former national team player turned advocate for professional women's hockey. Involved in the founding of the PWHL. Writing about what it took to build a sustainable women's league and what comes next.

name: Kai Nakamura
headline: Goaltending coach | NHL and international
biography: Goaltending consultant who has worked with fourteen NHL goalies over fifteen years. Also coach for the national team. Writing about the position that is least understood by fans and most mismanaged by organisations.

name: Isabel Ferreira
headline: Hockey historian | The original six and the expansion era
biography: Historian of professional hockey in North America. Research on the Original Six era, the 1967 expansion, and how the NHL became a continental league. Writing about the history of the game for fans who want to understand where it came from.

name: Aaron Brooks
headline: Hockey scout | Draft evaluation and prospect analysis
biography: Professional scout with experience at both the NHL and international levels. Evaluated hundreds of draft prospects over fifteen years. Writing about what scouts actually look for and how the evaluation process works — and where it breaks down.

name: Layla Ahmed
headline: Sports psychologist | Performance and elite athlete mental health
biography: Sports psychologist working with professional hockey players on performance, identity, and transition out of the game. Writing about the mental side of elite sport that teams are only beginning to take seriously.

name: Ryan Murphy
headline: Hockey broadcaster | Play-by-play and colour commentary
biography: Play-by-play broadcaster with experience at the AHL and NHL levels. Also does colour commentary for international tournaments. Writing about the craft of hockey broadcasting and the responsibility of being the voice of the game for millions of fans.

name: Vera Sokolova
headline: Senior Software Engineer | Distributed systems
biography: Backend engineer specialising in distributed systems and high-throughput data pipelines. Eight years in production engineering. Writing about the engineering decisions that matter at scale and the ones that only seemed like they would.

name: Nathan Ellis
headline: Engineering Manager | Platform and infrastructure
biography: Managing platform engineering teams for six years. Transitioned from individual contributor after realising I could have more impact helping others do their best work than doing my own. Writing about technical leadership, hiring, and team design.

name: Yara Hassan
headline: Indie hacker | Bootstrapped SaaS products
biography: Left a comfortable engineering job to build software products independently. Currently running two profitable SaaS tools. Writing honestly about the revenue numbers, the hard months, and the decisions that made the difference.

name: Ethan Price
headline: Frontend Engineer | React and web performance
biography: Frontend engineer obsessed with Core Web Vitals and the user experience of fast interfaces. Building components libraries and arguing about accessibility. Writing about the craft of frontend work that too many engineers treat as a second-class discipline.

name: Nina Schneider
headline: DevOps engineer | Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure
biography: Infrastructure engineer who has seen organisations succeed and fail at Kubernetes adoption. Writing about the operational realities of cloud-native systems, the hidden costs of complexity, and when simpler is the right answer.

name: Oscar Martinez
headline: Security engineer | Application security and threat modelling
biography: Application security engineer who has spent ten years finding vulnerabilities before attackers do. Currently leading a security programme at a fintech. Writing about practical security engineering without the fear-mongering.

name: Lily Thompson
headline: Staff engineer | Database systems and query optimisation
biography: Staff engineer spending most of my time in the database layer — query plans, index design, and the mysteries of the PostgreSQL planner. Writing about database performance for engineers who know SQL but not the internals.

name: Ahmed Khalil
headline: Technical writer | Developer documentation and API design
biography: Technical writer who came from engineering and went back to explain it. Working with teams to build documentation that developers actually read. Writing about the craft of technical communication and why most docs fail the people who need them.

name: Maya Okonkwo
headline: Software architect | Event-driven systems and microservices
biography: Architect helping organisations move from monoliths to distributed systems without creating distributed monoliths. Ten years of making these mistakes so teams I work with do not have to. Writing about architecture decisions that age well.
